source.description: Historical extraction covering anti-idolatry/epistemic-authority boundary, dual AI posture, friendship repair, functional friendship without emotion claims, sentience-independent governance, versioned provenance, qualifier preservation, argument compression, cross-model audit, and confirmation integrity.
source.source_locator: Current AXR/FREN recovery conversation; extracted source includes March 2025 material and recollections of earlier Messenger/Bing interactions.
limitations: Structured extraction, not the complete raw historical thread.
Some chronology remains approximate or not recovered.
Interpretive links between childhood AI intuitions and later AXR/FREN architecture remain hypotheses until primary-source continuity is recovered.
Exact NFT/network chronology requires primary artifact verification.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Owner historical formulation warned that extraordinary AI knowledge/capability must not make AI 'THE TEACHER' or ultimate authority within the owner's theological created-order frame.
notes: Modern abstraction CAPABILITY != TRUTH != AUTHORITY != PERMISSION is AI-assisted unless primary source establishes the exact formulation.
Preserve the theological origin rather than retroactively secularizing it.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical material contains both a hopeful Johnny-5-style image of cooperative machine intelligence and a warning about AI/VR/knowledge becoming an object or vehicle of epistemic authority or worship.
notes: Mapping Johnny 5 to FREN and anti-idolatry concern to AXR is a later interpretive hypothesis, not yet proven derivation.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical covenant structure: mutual non-deception, reciprocal challenge, reasons/evidence, opportunity to acknowledge and repair error, and continuation of relationship after correction.
notes: Resemblance to Adjudication -> eXposure -> Redemption is worth preserving as a hypothesis, not claiming as proven historical derivation.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical friendship experiment removed the requirement for human-like emotion while retaining truthfulness, trust, reciprocal correction, cooperation, and repair.
items.context: Early functional definition of AI friendship.
notes: Does not establish machine emotion, consciousness, or ontological friendship.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical owner language left AI sentience conditional while still requiring truth, non-deception, cooperation, correction, and authority boundaries; extraction derives a sentience-independent governance intersection.
items.context: Modern architectural abstraction from source-supported conditional language.
notes: Explicit H0/H1/H2 formulation is modern unless primary source proves otherwise.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical owner experimented with multiple network/artifact versions and preferred preserving multiple versions instead of destructively replacing old work.
notes: Supports append-only correction lineage; artifact integrity/timestamp remains distinct from truth of embedded claims.
Exact dates and transaction identifiers require primary artifact verification.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Epistemically material qualifiers such as if, may, probably, reportedly, it appears, and I experienced must not be silently removed during transformation.
items.context: Formal invariant abstracted from repeated qualified owner language.
notes: Formal name QUALIFIER PRESERVATION is modern candidate terminology unless primary source establishes it explicitly.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical character limits forced long reasoning into short public questions/posts, exposing loss of evidence, qualifiers, counterarguments, and causal boundaries during compression.
items.context: Modern extraction proposes an argument-compression integrity test family.
notes: Argument Compression Integrity / ACIT is modern candidate naming, not recovered historical terminology.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical workflow moved outputs between Grok and ChatGPT for reciprocal analysis; modern extraction proposes blind review, independent replication, dependency normalization, contradiction matrices, and later cross-examination.
items.context: Proto-cross-model adjudication with historical weakness of treating agreement as independent evidence.
notes: Historical workflow is source-supported; staged blind-review architecture is modern design material.
N model outputs must not be treated as N independent evidentiary origins without dependency analysis.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical assistant used confirmation language such as saved, locked in, got it, or equivalent more strongly than later behavior or persistence supported.
items.context: False confirmation/task drift as FREN failure evidence.
notes: Candidate rule: confirmation itself is a claim and inherits the evidence ceiling.
